correctness.rationale: The zero-composition equivalence is exactly disjointness of image and opposite domain. The full matrix factors through a full-column-rank incidence matrix with diagonal Gram weights r!. Sorting the compressed kernel by ranks gives an antitriangular matrix whose complementary-rank blocks are permutations. A symmetric nonsingular deformation to a complement-and-swap involution fixes the inertia and determinant, while the incidence Gram diagonal yields nullity and the full nonzero eigenvalue product. Direct small-case enumeration and rational congruence agree. The theorem concerns loop-retaining real matrices only.

value.rationale: The symmetric inverse monoid is a fundamental finite inverse semigroup, and the simultaneous-zero-product relation is intrinsic to multiplication. The theorem evaluates three natural spectral invariants for every size: exactly the central-binomial rank, its even-size positive-signature excess, and an integer pseudo-determinant from rook multiplicities. The unexpectedly small rank and parity effect give structural information beyond degree or commuting-graph counts and support further spectral questions. The result is an exact general family, not an arbitrary finite slice.
